In Reviter, load the model and room reviews, save GIS reference points, then choose Prepare OpenIndoorMaps project. Import that ZIP here. You can also select your finalized master Reviter ZIP. The package is processed in this browser; keep exported ZIPs as backups.

Check buildings and campus floors.
Select areas and door or stair markers to inspect source metadata.
Choose start and destination; inspect each floor of the route.
Review public access and step-free connections, then export the reviewed package.

Original RVT bytes, floor boundaries, source identities and GIS references remain in the package.
